title: The complete K action on K/M has kernel exactly Z(K)

kernel_theorem.subgroup: M=Z_K(A) is finite for the split Cartan A.
kernel_theorem.homogeneous_kernel: ker(K acting on K/M)=core_K(M)=intersection_k k M k^{-1}.
kernel_theorem.core_to_center: The core is a finite normal subgroup of connected K, so every conjugacy orbit in the core is a singleton and core_K(M) is contained in Z(K).
kernel_theorem.center_to_core: Every element of Z(K) centralizes A, lies in M and lies in every conjugate of M, so Z(K) is contained in core_K(M).
kernel_theorem.center: Z(K)=(Z2 x Z2)/diagonal Z2={1,z} with z=[-1,1].
kernel_theorem.hilbert_kernel: The quasi-regular representation on H_ps=L2(K/M) has the same kernel because a nontrivial continuous coset motion moves an open set of positive measure.

claim_ceiling: The complete repository control K/M and L2(K/M) actions have kernel exactly the two-element center. This does not select a physical quotient or source action.
